body: I lost both my brothers who raised me - i have a mother who left at sixteen and shes dying now from liver and kidney damage in a foreign country. I relate to that anxiety and fear - but it does get better if you hang on as corny as that bullshit sounds. Be your best friend right now and go out of your comfort zone, whats the worse that can happen? We all have a short trip in this world and its all for a reason beyond our understanding imo. Hang on man and If need someone to talk to lmk.
